decisive_items: coagulative necrosis with frequent karyorrhexis and a lymphoplasmacytoid infiltrate
tender, non-mobile, 3 × 4 cm lymph node in the left axilla
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because its biopsy findings of coagulative necrosis and karyorrhexis are characteristic of Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease. R1 is the runner-up due to the presence of lymphoplasmacytoid infiltrate, but it lacks specific features of Castleman disease.

rejected.why: normal laboratory studies make Sarcoidosis less likely
Rosai-Dorfman disease is less likely due to the absence of specific clinical features
